scientific_goal: OOD physical dynamics perturbation of native joint drive gains, held-out new seeded true double ACK fault cohort, and deployment-available PRE-fault known-ACK response witness to gate latent controller target authority. The previous static failure rates were obtained only under one nominal drive tuning; this explicitly shifts the physical system while leaving the native action ABI fixed.

heldout.task_physical_truth: 16 fully held and 16 physically applied t2 and 16 t3 per task; 8 AA/AH/HA/HH per task
heldout.execution_truth_t2: native arm physical command APPLIED iff seed even

physical_dynamics_domain_precommit.changed_quantity: for EACH Panda arm joint panda_joint1..panda_joint7, modify PhysX PD drive stiffness and damping via ManiSkill articulated joint wrapper API AFTER reset BEFORE first physical step. Force limit remains 100.
physical_dynamics_domain_precommit.nominal_source: official ManiSkill Panda stiffness 1000 damping 100 force_limit 100; source and ALL nine destination controller worlds are modified identically for a matched source competence check and actual control dynamic comparison
physical_dynamics_domain_precommit.assignment: if floor(seed/4)%2==0: slow-drive stiffness=500,damping=70; else fast-drive stiffness=1500,damping=130. Each of the four ACK truth classes appears with 4 slow and 4 fast states per task.
physical_dynamics_domain_precommit.physical_joints: must find exactly seven panda_joint1..panda_joint7 and independently read back postsetter physical stiffness/damping from each world. Failing to apply or verify drive gain is injection failure; do not hide such cases or count as success.

new_method.name: Known-ACK Anchor Validity Gate (KAVG)
new_method.old_model: original prior publicly calibrated task-specific fixed response epsilon for frozen public t4 after actual known neutral arm action, Pull 0.006944262561376447m Stack 0.00719087965534261m and competitor gap 0.002m
new_method.anchor_timing: Step 1 BEFORE any uncertain ACK; action is physically delivered and acknowledged, so an observer's complete native target is already known from its OWN publicly tracked action history. Measure achieved XYZ before/after real physical native step1. Obtain predicted target XYZ solely from the observer's acknowledged action history, never from native private target getter.
new_method.anchor_decision: Compute Euclidean shortest distance from publicly observed after-XYZ to scalar segment from preXYZ to the KNOWN tracked native target XYZ, with alpha in [0,1]. Accept anchor as model-valid only if planned native target displacement >= 0.01m and residual <= predeclared original task epsilon; otherwise abstain from public history identification at t4. Anchor validity must NOT use any hidden native state getter or ACK injection truth.
new_method.final_public_step4: At common known-delivered native ZERO t4, compute original public four-history nearest segment and competitor margin. Public authority is permitted only when BOTH original t4 full history separation AND valid PRE-fault t1 known-target response anchor. Otherwise use ONE counted private controller memory getter at t5.
new_method.old_frozen_public_comparator: Identical physical step1/t4 native actions, same unchanged old empirical epsilon, but no t1 anchor gating and exactly two public XYZ samples at t4. Account anchor's two extra public achieved XYZ measurements as a real cost.
new_method.other_controls: the existing 8 real stepped source, continuously private oracle, optimistic ACK, exact refusal, bounded no query, task-sensitive selective read, always-query t5 and always-held zero-read world
new_method.prevent_input_leakage: policy knows which t1 target it issued and received ACK to; training/evaluation source native target may be read ONLY post-physical audit. No source policy action differences except the method deciding query vs native history at t5.

fixed_hypotheses.primary: In changed physical joint-drive regime, model-validity (true t4 history residual within old epsilon), false confident native target-history label, explicit privileged target reads, official task successes and material disaggregated gate behavior under slow/fast × task × all four ACK execution combinations.
fixed_hypotheses.null: The t1 anchor may have no predictive power for t4 validity, thus extra public observations and readbacks with zero observed risk improvement; report as negative if so.
fixed_hypotheses.strong_controls: same task-specific selected comparator and fixed t5 read; no actual full ActionShift active method run — do not falsely name as such.
